Clean playful casual-game illustration, chunky simplified shapes, flat-to-soft cel shading, crisp readable silhouette, bright saturated palette, low texture noise, no realism, no fake lettering. MAP 2 — POST-APOCALYPTIC OVERGROWN CITY.

LEFT ENTRY -> short shared lane -> obvious Y SPLIT -> TWO SEPARATE PARALLEL/ARCING ROUTES -> obvious Y MERGE -> short shared lane -> RIGHT EXIT.

Exactly 12 large, blank, circular build pads:
3 along shared lane before split,
3 serving upper branch,
3 serving lower branch,
3 at merge/final section.

Cute overgrown post-apocalyptic city: simplified blank building facades, cracked asphalt, vines, flower growth, rusted cars, sewer water, low barricades, rooftop gardens, radio antenna, bunker hatch, steam pipes. Friendly adventurous tone.

NO TEXT OF ANY KIND:

ANIMATION-READY PROPS:
separate amber beacon lights, one rotating antenna dish, two steam vents, flowing canal water, loose leaves/paper, reserved open area for future toxic dust cloud.

SECRETS:
closed bunker hatch on lower branch, small maintenance tunnel, hidden radio relay node on upper branch.

BASE only: no toxic storm active, no characters, no enemies, no towers.
